profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Procore Technologies
profile.summary: I am a full-stack software engineer seeking to implement my skills to help build tools that will have a greater impact on the community as well as improve lives. I have a strong background in Javascript which includes working with Angular.js on the front end as well as Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB and ElasticSearch on the backend.  I thrive in a creative and challenging environment and enjoy tackling problems in a collaborative setting.

positions.title: Frontend Infrastructure Engineer
positions.description:
•  Launched and drove frontend observability for ~20 front end teams by integrating Sentry features 
•  Built a Go version management service that enabled click deploys to Kubernetes for frontend applications
•  Created an internal dashboard that fetched data from multiple APIs  and measured  frontend applications’ code quality and resilience
•  Wrote manifest compiler that automatically generated routes and configurations for server side rendered SPAs 
•  Author: Engineering blog with technical details on launching and building hybrid applications with ~10K traffic
•  Led engineering bootcamp with curriculum created to onboard engineers on front-end architecture, observability(Sentry), and best practices of CLI tools

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
*Full stack work on Autodesk’s business applications and services, enabling a smooth transition into more flexible subscription licensing models
*Worked on Node.js backend, interfacing with Apigee and microservices architecture
*Directed and implemented Node upgrade for five applications to meet PCI compliance standards that resulted in support for new ES6 features as well as performance and security improvements
*Optimized Autodesk e-commerce checkout experience by rewriting reusable price quote tax service resulting in quicker and consistent UI responses for the customer
*Debugged, refactored and optimized Node middleware that ensures consistent asynchronous calls to Demandbase service based on IP data while also ensuring correct error handling

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
*Contracted to develop a platform that manages job references and validates resumes
*Implemented React components with Redux to manage both data and UI states while maintaining a unidirectional data flow

positions.title: General Manager
positions.description:
A family-run wholesale greenhouse business specializing in foliage.
*Managed financial logistics of a wholesale greenhouse with over 1.1M in profits.
*Executed scalable changes that lowered marginal costs, increasing (FYE) by over 60% from 2011-2014.
*Responsible for accounts payable and accounts receivable transactions, client relations, and production planning.

positions.title: Violinist and Educator
positions.description:
*Performances with internationally acclaimed opera singers from the Metropolitan Opera to London's   Royal Opera House
*Educator with Austin Lyric Opera's Access Opera Program-participated in dress rehearsals that provided free tickets to students, teachers, and parents in hopes of sparking a lifelong interest in opera

positions.title: Violinist and Educator
positions.description:
*Performances that not only included classical symphonic repertoire, but also collaborated with pop artists such as Andrea Bocelli.
*Participated in arts outreach classical concerts that provided free concerts for local public elementary and middle school students.

positions.title: Violinist
positions.description:
*Collaborations and performances with Wet Ink, a NYC-based new music collective. 
*Premiered works by NYC-based, international award-winning composers including Alex Mincek, Kate Soper (Guggenheim), and Eric Wubbels.

positions.title: Targeted Education in Music Faculty
positions.description:
*Awarded a “teaching artist in residency” grant through the California Arts Council 
*Awarded a teaching grant to attend Mimi Zweig and Suzuki teacher training workshops
*Selected by the NCCO to help initiate and expand an arts outreach program targeting underserved students in Marin County schools.  
*Intensively worked with hand-selected students (ages 5-13) who received instrumental musical instruction free of charge for the school year
*Identified weaknesses in the classroom structure and implemented changes in the curriculum

certifications.name: Shiva Rea fluid-power yoga teacher certification
certifications.title: Shiva Rea fluid-power yoga teacher certification

projects.title: CookedIn
projects.description:
A job search website targeting chefs designed to streamline the hiring process.
*Architected REST endpoints in Node.js and Express in order to ease development by keeping servers stateless and cache-able.
*Designed and rendered HTML pages using Angular.js routes that provided seamless transitions throughout the website.

projects.title: Habit Tracker
projects.description:
A daily habit tracker developed to help users achieve goals in their lives through small daily steps.
*Crafted a responsive user interface with React.js that tracked whether the user achieved their goals.
*Implemented Flux’s unidirectional data flow resulting in dynamic responses to user interaction.
